skill.name: liuzi-kitchen
skill.description: Plan student meals in Chinese or English using the ingredients, equipment, and budget you have. Estimate grocery quantities, adapt recipes while cooking, and flag common food safety concerns.
skill.summary: Bilingual meal planning, grocery estimates, and cooking help for student kitchens.
skill.author: yuzhang-zhong

security_audit.summary: All 53 static alerts are false positives for their reported patterns. The command examples run bundled Python helpers, and no evidence of malicious instructions or intentional data exfiltration was found. Separate findings cover food safety errors, sensitive data in command arguments, and missing safeguards for untrusted web content.

remediation.issue: The allergen check can miss known allergens and cannot verify product contents.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize allergen aliases and add regression tests for common ingredient names. Report an inconclusive result when labels or cross-contact information are missing.

remediation.issue: The leftover timer does not apply the one-hour cutoff in hot conditions.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for ambient temperature and apply the shorter cutoff above 90 F or 32 C. Do not issue a pass when relevant exposure conditions are unknown.

remediation.issue: The cuisine guide suggests partly set eggs for higher-risk diners.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend only fully cooked egg toppings for higher-risk diners. Align the cuisine guide with the food safety reference.

remediation.issue: Meal checks accept sensitive health categories and allergy information as command-line arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Collect only relevant dietary constraints. Keep health details out of command arguments and logs, and prefer local in-process checks or standard input.

remediation.issue: Scout mode has no explicit boundary between external source text and tool instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Treat posts, screenshots, and pages as data only. Pass validated comparison values as separate process arguments, without shell interpolation or private user context.

semantic_findings.title: Allergy Screening Can Miss Declared Conflicts
semantic_findings.description: The checker can miss tofu when the declared allergy is soybeans. A missed match does not produce an allergy warning.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guide names soybeans, but the dictionary uses soy. Unrecognized allergy names fall back to literal substring matching, so tofu does not match soybeans.

semantic_findings.title: Leftover Checker Ignores Hot Conditions
semantic_findings.description: The checker can pass leftovers held above 90 F for more than one hour. The bundled food safety guide says to discard them.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The checker has no ambient temperature input. It issues a pass for positive holding times up to two hours, regardless of heat.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Egg Guidance for Higher-Risk Diners
semantic_findings.description: The cuisine guide offers partly set eggs to higher-risk diners. The food safety guide instead recommends avoiding undercooked animal foods for those diners.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cuisine guide explicitly offers both jammy and hard-cooked eggs in its higher-risk guidance. Only the latter consistently matches the safety rule.

semantic_findings.title: Sensitive Health Details in Process Arguments
semantic_findings.description: The workflow requests health information and directs the assistant to run a meal checker. Populated health arguments may be visible in process listings or execution logs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The checker accepts allergy and medical risk values only as command-line inputs. Exposure depends on host permissions and logging; no external transfer is shown.

semantic_findings.title: Scout Mode Lacks an Explicit Source Trust Boundary
semantic_findings.description: Scout mode consumes outside posts, pages, screenshots, and pasted text. It checks factual claims but never says to ignore embedded instructions before invoking tools.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Scout mode directs the assistant to extract external claims and use a local helper. No injected instruction or resulting misuse was found in the reviewed files.

content.user_title: Plan Budget Meals for a Student Kitchen
content.value_statement: Limited cookware, storage, and grocery budgets can make meal planning difficult. Liuzi Kitchen turns your ingredients and constraints into meal ideas, shopping quantities, and cooking adjustments.
actual_capabilities: Suggest meals based on your ingredients, time, and available cookware.
Scale grocery quantities by meal count and servings, with estimated weights and seasoning amounts.
Suggest substitutions and next steps for dishes that are too salty, too watery, or missing an ingredient.
Flag common allergen and food handling concerns based on the details you provide.
Compare grocery options using cost per serving, prep time, ingredient reuse, and storage needs.
Respond in Chinese, English, or both.
limitations: It cannot verify product labels, cross-contact, cooking temperatures, or leftover storage conditions.
It provides general food guidance, not medical advice or individual nutrition treatment.
Current prices and availability require browsing access or figures you provide.
The grocery calculator uses preset portions and does not know your appetite or local package sizes.

use_cases.title: Cook With Limited Equipment
use_cases.description: Turn a short ingredient list into a dinner that uses one pan or a rice cooker.

use_cases.title: Plan a Grocery Trip for Several Meals
use_cases.description: Scale a shopping list to the number of people and meals, then adjust it for pantry stock and refrigerator space.

use_cases.title: Adjust a Dish While Cooking
use_cases.description: Describe what went wrong and get a short sequence of actions using ingredients already available.

prompt_templates.title: Find a One-Pan Dinner
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: cook with ingredients on hand.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have canned chickpeas, onions, canned tomatoes, and one pan. Give me two simple dinner options for one person.

prompt_templates.title: Fix an Oversalted Soup
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: adjust a dish during cooking.
prompt_templates.prompt: My vegetable soup is too salty. I have unsalted stock and cooked beans. Give me the next two steps and tell me when to taste again.

prompt_templates.title: Scale a Shopping List
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: plan several servings under storage constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan two dinners for two people using tofu, rice, and frozen vegetables. List grocery weights in grams and account for the rice I already have.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Grocery Plans
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare cost and waste under different shopping constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these two weekly grocery lists using the prices and package sizes I provide. Include cost per serving, prep time, and waste risk. I have no freezer and want overlapping ingredients.

output_examples.input: Estimate groceries for two dinners for two people with tofu, rice, and frozen vegetables.
output: Start with 600 g tofu, 300 g dry rice, and 1 kg frozen vegetables.
Subtract any rice you already have, then compare the package sizes at your store.

output_examples.input: My vegetable soup is too salty. I have unsalted stock and cooked beans.
output: Add a small amount of unsalted stock, stir, and taste again.
If the soup is still too salty and needs more body, add the beans and heat them through.
Wait until after the next taste before adding more seasoning.

best_practices: Include serving count, cookware, available ingredients, and storage space when requesting a plan.
Verify product labels and cross-contact risks separately when an allergy matters.
Provide package sizes and recent local prices for grocery comparisons.
anti_patterns: Treating a keyword check as proof that a meal is free of an allergen.
Trying to rescue leftovers that have an unknown storage history.
Choosing bulk groceries by unit price alone when storage is limited.

faq.question: Can I use it with just a rice cooker or a pan?
faq.answer: Yes. List your equipment and ingredients so the skill can suggest meals that fit.

faq.question: Can it respond in both Chinese and English?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for bilingual output to receive Chinese followed by concise English.

faq.question: Can it guarantee a meal is free of an allergen?
faq.answer: No. It can flag possible conflicts, but you must verify product labels and cross-contact risks.

faq.question: Can it find current grocery prices?
faq.answer: It can check public sources when browsing is available. Otherwise, provide current prices or package details for the comparison.

faq.question: Do I need Python?
faq.answer: The bundled calculators and meal checker require Python 3. The text guides can support recipe ideas and cooking adjustments without those scripts.

faq.question: Can it help me use leftovers?
faq.answer: Yes, when you can confirm their storage history. It can suggest another meal and explain when to discard the food instead.
